name: week
title: Production test review
subtitle: Observed records only. First observed is not lifetime first pass.

sections.title: First observed yield
sections.sql: SELECT source,part_number||' / '||revision AS product,process_code AS process,observed_units AS units,first_observed_pass_pct AS first_observed_pass_percent,retested_units AS retested,latest_pass_units AS latest_pass FROM v_yield ORDER BY source,part_number,process_code

sections.title: Retested units
sections.sql: SELECT source,part_number||' / '||revision AS product,serial_number,process_code AS process,attempts,first_result,latest_result FROM v_units WHERE attempts>1 ORDER BY source,part_number,serial_number

sections.title: Failure patterns
sections.sql: SELECT source,part_number||' / '||revision AS product,station,step,failed_step_occurrences AS failures,affected_reports FROM v_failures ORDER BY failed_step_occurrences DESC
